Meeting rooms at 14 Crane Street: Room A seats 8 and has a screen; Room B seats 14 and has the projector and speakerphone.
Thank you for the engagement letter. Nadia Hartley is the contact for the Hartley & Moss year-end review; her email is nadia@hartleyandmoss.example.
